headline: Quebecor and Telesat Explore Partnership on Lightspeed Satellite Constellation
summary: Quebecor and Telesat held preliminary talks regarding potential technology collaboration on Telesat's low-Earth orbit Lightspeed satellite constellation, though no capital deal has been finalized.
why: LEO satellite networks are becoming critical infrastructure for enterprise connectivity and broadband access across remote territories.

impacts.name: Telesat
impacts.why: Commercial exploration with a major domestic telecom partner could expand the eventual subscriber base of Lightspeed.
